blocks.html: Competitive Analysis is the systematic evaluation of competitors’ strengths, weaknesses, positioning, pricing, and strategies to identify market opportunities and competitive advantages.

Competitive analysis helps businesses understand their position in the market relative to competitors. By studying how competitors operate, companies can uncover gaps, refine their strategies, and differentiate their offerings more effectively.
Competitive analysis involves gathering and analyzing data on key competitors, including:

items.html: Product or service offerings and features
Marketing channels and customer engagement strategies

blocks.html: This information is used to benchmark performance and identify areas for improvement or differentiation.
Identifies market gaps and growth opportunities
A SaaS company analyzes its competitors’ pricing tiers, feature sets, and customer reviews to identify underserved segments and refine its value proposition accordingly.

Competitive analysis is essential for staying ahead in a dynamic market. By continuously monitoring competitors, businesses can adapt strategies, capitalize on opportunities, and build a stronger competitive edge.
